mechanism: Tretinoin is a CYP3A4 substrate and inducer that may alter everolimus metabolism, a CYP3A4 substrate, potentially reducing everolimus levels; both drugs also have overlapping toxicity profiles affecting skin and mucous membranes.
action: Monitor everolimus trough concentrations and clinical efficacy closely; assess for signs of reduced immunosuppressive effect or increased tretinoin-related toxicity; consider dose adjustments if significant interactions are observed.
